trial_court: Court of Ms. Nirja Bhatia, District Judge (Comm. Court-07), South-East District, Saket Court, New Delhi, CS (Comm) 596/2022
case_name: M/S Maxposure Media Group (I) Pvt Ltd vs M/S Oyster Communications And Other

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: M/S Maxposure Media Group (I) Pvt Ltd, plaintiff
parties.respondent_defendant: M/S Oyster Communications and its partners Sh. Arjun Daima and Kailash Daima

facts_of_case: M/S Maxposure Media Group (I) Pvt Ltd filed a suit for recovery of Rs. 15,84,010/- alongwith pendente lite and future interest @ 24% p.a. against M/S Oyster Communications and its partners.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party claiming a fact to prove it.
legal_principles.held: He was confronted with release orders dated 28.11.2019, reference No. 651 (Ex. DW-1/P-1), and on being so confronted he replied that M/s Oyester Communication he cannot say about these release orders were sent at plaintiff's Delhi office or at Mumbai office.

legal_principles.principle: A party's denial of a fact can be used to prove the opposite.
legal_principles.held: He denied that the flights were discontinued w.e.f 25.03.2020 and stated that on different dates the decision of discontinuation was taken by different airports.

outcome.final_order: The court decided that the plaintiff was entitled to recover Rs. 15,84,010/- alongwith pendente lite and future interest @ 24% p.a. from the defendants.
